text: dsh-pages 让 DSH 模型把回答做成可交互网页：通过 show_page 工具提交模板数据或完整 HTML，并把页面嵌入对话或显示为缩略卡片。它提供报告、对比、清单、看板、时间线、学习卡片、测验和流程图模板，也支持手写页面；页面可跟随深浅色、保存交互状态、保留版本，并在右侧栏浏览、导出 HTML、PNG 或 PDF。适合把分析、计划、图表和小工具做成可操作页面的 DSH 用户。无需 API 密钥；PNG/PDF 导出和自动体检需要本机可用的 Chrome 或 Edge。

dsh-pages turns DSH answers into interactive pages using eight templates or supplied HTML. Pages appear in chat or the sidebar, follow light and dark themes, retain versions and state, and export as HTML, PNG, or PDF. No API key is needed; Chrome or Edge is required for checks and image/PDF export.
想把一段分析整理成能交互浏览的网页，而不是只看长文字。
DSH 能不能把方案比较做成卡片和表格，并标出推荐项？
我想生成一个可以勾选并自动记住进度的清单页面。
需要在聊天里展示数据看板、图表和指标。
做好的页面想保留旧版本，还能回到以前的版本。
有没有办法把模型生成的页面导出成图片、PDF 或 HTML？
Turn an answer into an interactive page embedded in my DSH conversation.
Create a quiz or flashcards from study notes and keep my progress.
dsh-pages 的功能「模板生成」：模型调用 show_page 并提交模板名与数据，即可生成报告、对比、清单、数据看板、时间线、学习卡片、测验或流程图页面；插件负责校验内容并排版。
dsh-pages 的功能「聊天内页面」：生成的页面可直接嵌在对话回复下方，也可只显示缩略卡片；用户还能在右侧栏打开整页查看。
dsh-pages 的功能「版本和状态保存」：再次调用时传入 page_id 会将页面保存为新版本，旧版本保留供查看；页面交互状态也可按页面持久保存。
dsh-pages 的功能「页面导出」：用户可从右侧页面查看器选择导出 HTML、PNG 或 PDF；导出文件写入本机 Downloads 文件夹。
dsh-pages 的页面体检和 PNG/PDF 导出使用本机 Chrome 或 Edge；没有可用浏览器时体检会跳过，非 HTML 导出不可用。
dsh-pages 将页面及其版本、交互状态保存在本机用户目录的 ~/.dsh/dsh-pages/ 下。

简体中文 · English

让 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）的模型把回答做成一页网页：对比、清单、图表、计算器、测验……页面**直接嵌在回复下面**，能点能用，深浅色跟着 DSH 走，填过的东西重开还在。改一次存一版，旧版留着能翻；右侧栏看整页，一键导出 PNG / PDF / HTML。 常见的报告、对比、清单、数据看板、时间线、学习卡片、测验、流程图有**现成模板**：模型只写内容，插件负责排版和交互，出得快、省 token、不会写坏；模板放不下的才让模型写整页网页。

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Introduction：> **一句话**：DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件，模型用 `show_page` 把回答做成一页，直接显示在对话里、能交互；8 种常用模板只写内容就行，跟随深浅色、有版本、存好自动体检、能导出。
>
> **什么时候用**：「做成一页给我看」「做个房贷计算器」「三款手机对比一下」——看一页比读一段字清楚的时候。
>
> **安装**：DSH「插件」页 →「添加插件」，填 `@orderg-x/dsh-pages`（npm 包，连不上 npm 会自动换国内镜像），重启 DSH。
>
> **English:** a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin. The model calls `show_page` to turn an answer into a web page that lives right in the chat — either by filling one of 8 built-in templates (report, compare, checklist, dashboard, timeline, flashcards, quiz, flow: the model writes only the content) or by writing a full page, which picks up the same design automatically. Pages are interactive, following DSH's light/dark theme, versioned (edit → v2, flip back anytime), checked automatically in a headless browser after saving, opened full-size in the right sidebar, and exported to PNG / PDF / HTML. Install: on the DSH Plugins page, click Add plugin and enter `@orderg-x/dsh-pages`, then restart DSH.

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · 安装：在 DSH「插件」页点「添加插件」，填包名：

```
@orderg-x/dsh-pages
```

这是 npm 包：按包名装时，DSH 连不上 npm 官方源会自动改用国内镜像（npmmirror），不经过 GitHub。也可以填发布包地址 `https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-pages/releases/latest/download/dsh-pages.tgz`，那样要能连上 GitHub。

装完**重启 DSH**（客户端代码在 DSH 启动时打包，不重启看不到页面）。DSH「插件」页里显示为「页面」。

**更新**：DSH 0.2.2 起，在「插件」页点开它，点「更新到 …」；更老的 DSH 先卸载，再按上面添加一次。新版发布后大约一天才装得到（DSH 装插件用的 pnpm 默认不装刚发布的版本）；急的话卸载后填发布包地址，不过这样装的以后不能点更新。

开发时可以直接链到本地目录：在「添加插件」里填本仓库的绝对路径，装上的是 `link:`，改了代码同样要重启。

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · 用起来是什么样：1. **写的时候**：工具组里先出一张骨架卡片，「正在写页面… 已写 12 KB」。
2. **写好了**：页面直接嵌在回复下面，一出来就是内容的高度（体检时量好了，不跳）；太高先收起，点「展开」看全。长报告类模型可以选只放一张缩略图卡片。
3. **右侧栏**：点「在右侧打开」看整页；顶上能翻版本（‹ v2 / 3 ›）、导出、刷新；「‹ 全部页面」是做过的所有页面（带缩略图）。右侧栏「+」里也有「我的页面」入口。
4. **再改**：说「把标题改大一点」，模型带上 `page_id` 再调一次，存成 v2。对话里旧回合还是 v1，新回合是 v2。
5. **我的页面**：页面多了能搜标题；不要的点「×」再点「确定删除？」，整页挪进回收站（`~/.dsh/dsh-pages/trash/`，挪回 `pages/` 就回来了）。
6. **手机上**（配合 [dsh-mobile](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-mobile)）：页面照样嵌在对话里，标题栏按钮自动变短；「在右侧打开」铺满整屏。

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · 模板：| 模板 | 适合 | 页面里能做什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `report` 报告 | 复盘、调研、总结 | 摘要、指标卡、分节（文字 / 列表 / 表格 / 提示框）、来源 |
| `compare` 对比 | 选手机、选方案 | 卡片 / 表格切换，「只看不同」，数越大（或越小）越好的自动标出最好的，推荐项高亮 |
| `checklist` 清单 / 计划 | 待办、出行、搬家 | 勾选自动保存，进度条，「只看没做的」，重置 |
| `dashboard` 数据看板 | 周报、销量、流量 | 指标卡带涨跌，柱状图 / 折线图 / 环形图（自己画，不靠外部库），鼠标移上去看数 |
| `timeline` 时间线 | 计划、历史、进度 | 已完成 / 进行中 / 没开始 |
| `flashcards` 学习卡片 | 背单词、记概念 | 点卡片翻面，「记住了」计数，只看没记住的，打乱 |
| `quiz` 测验 | 自测、出题 | 点了就判对错、给解释、算分，重做 |
| `flow` 流程图 | 审批、操作步骤 | 自动分层排版，判断分叉、跨层和往回的连线自动绕开 |
@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · 模板：文字里能用 `**加粗**`、`` `代码` ``、`[链接](https://…)`；页面上的按钮文字跟着内容的语言走（中文 / 英文）。

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · 深浅色：- 卡片、右侧栏用 DSH 自己的设计变量，跟着 DSH 走。
- 页面里也跟着换，**不重载**（填了的表单、拖过的滑块都还在）：页面送出去时塞一小段脚本，在 `<html>` 上设 `data-theme="light|dark"`、`data-bs-theme`、`.dark` 和 `color-scheme`，自己写的变量、Tailwind、DaisyUI、Bootstrap 都认。
- 页面里写的 `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` 也改成听 DSH 的（DSH 选了深色、系统是浅色时照样变深）。
- 模型自己写的页面带着上面那套设计的深浅色变量（`--bg` `--surface` `--fg` `--muted` `--line` `--accent` 等），用了就自动跟着切。

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · 页面能存东西：沙箱里本来一碰 `localStorage` / `sessionStorage` / cookie / IndexedDB 就报错，页面整个挂掉。插件换成了能用的：

- `localStorage` 按页面存进 DSH：待办勾了几项、计算器填的数，重开 DSH、模型改出新版本都还在。每页最多存 25 万字左右。
- 对话里和右侧栏同时开着同一页：页面听 `storage` 事件的，一边改了另一边马上跟上；不听的，鼠标移回另一边时整页重载成新的（旧的那份不会把刚改的盖掉）。
- `sessionStorage` 只在这次打开里有；cookie 读出来是空的；IndexedDB 当没有。

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · 自动体检：存好就在本机一个看不见的 Chrome / Edge 里打开（和对话里一样的沙箱），一两秒出结果，跟工具结果一起交给模型：

- 脚本报错、库从 CDN 载不进来、被沙箱拦下的请求
- 空白页
- 对话宽度（720px）和手机宽度（390px）下横向溢出，指出是哪个元素
- 深色模式下背景还是浅色
- 照对话里的做法嵌一遍，量出嵌进去的高度；用了 100vh 又加边距、越撑越长的页面会指出来

被沙箱拦下的会说清楚该怎么改（比如「页面不能联网取数据，把数据直接写进页面」），模型照着改就行。

有问题模型会改了再调一次；没问题就不用再检查。顺手截深浅两张缩略图给「我的页面」用。没装 Chrome / Edge 时跳过体检。

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · 用法：| 参数 | 必填 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | 是 | 页面标题，短一点 |
| `template` | 二选一 | 套模板：`report` / `compare` / `checklist` / `dashboard` / `timeline` / `flashcards` / `quiz` / `flow`，配 `data` |
| `data` | 套模板时 | 模板的内容（JSON），各模板的字段写在工具说明里，示例见 `test/fixtures/template-samples.mjs` |
| `html` | 二选一 | 不用模板时：完整、自包含的 HTML；样式脚本写在页面里，库可以从 cdn.jsdelivr.net / cdnjs.cloudflare.com / unpkg.com 引 |
| `page_id` | 否 | 改已有页面时填上次返回的 `page_id`，存成新版本 |
| `display` | 否 | `inline`（默认，嵌在对话里）或 `card`（只放缩略图卡片，点开在右侧看） |

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · 安全：- **页面关在沙箱里**：回应头带 `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox allow-scripts …`，页面跑在不透明源里，碰不到 DSH 的接口和 cookie；`connect-src 'none'`，不能 fetch / XHR / WebSocket；图片、音视频只收 `data:` / `blob:`（图标可以从三个 CDN 拉），页面没法把用户填的东西拼进图片地址发出去。脚本和样式只能从三个 CDN 拉。
- **页面自己跳走**：体检时一律拦下并告诉模型；对话里的页面跳走了会被拉回原页面。不过浏览器没法在跳转发出去之前拦住它，所以别在页面里填密码一类的东西。
- **要登录态**：页面和接口都交给 DSH 自己的 `connection` 服务验登录；老版本 DSH 没有这个服务时只收本机连接，并查 Host / Sec-Fetch-Site / Origin（防 DNS 重绑定、跨站）。
- **改东西的接口**（导出、在文件夹里显示、删页面、存页面数据）只收同源发来的 JSON；「在文件夹里显示」只认这次导出过的文件。
- **页面存的东西**只能存进它自己那一页（哪一页由外面的对话决定，页面说了不算），只收字符串、有上限；送回页面时转义过，存进去的 `</script>` 跳不出来。小脚本塞在文档最前面，注释里写的 `<head>` 骗不了它。
- **体检用的无头浏览器**没有 DSH 的 cookie：排到空位、真要开页面时才给它一个一分钟有效、只认那一页、只收本机连接的口令；载进来的不是这一页（口令过期、页面没了）就不记结果、不存缩略图。浏览器走 `--remote-debugging-pipe`（不开端口），临时用户目录用完就删。
- **存的文件**：同一页的写入排队，还有一把跨进程的锁（DSH 桌面端和命令行同时改同一页也不会丢版本）；`meta.json` 读进来先校验，版本号只认正整数，坏掉的记录不拖垮列表。页面数据存的是「改了什么」，两个窗口（比如电脑和手机）各改各的不会互相抹掉；页面关掉时马上存。

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · 存在哪：`~/.dsh/dsh-pages/pages/<page_id>/`：`meta.json`（标题、各版本、体检结果）、`v1.html`（模型给的原样 HTML）、`v1.jpg` / `v1-dark.jpg`（缩略图）、`state.json`（页面自己存的 localStorage）。删掉的在 `~/.dsh/dsh-pages/trash/`。导出的文件在「下载」里。

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · 架构：- `lib/index.js` —— 工具、路由、把门、导出
- `lib/design.js` —— 一套设计（颜色变量、基本样子、现成的类），模板和手写页面共用
- `lib/templates.js` —— 8 个模板：内容校验、排版、页面里的交互小脚本
- `lib/store.js` —— 存页面、版本、页面数据，删页面（同一页的写入排队）
- `lib/runtime.js` —— 塞进页面的小脚本：深浅色、报高度、外部链接新窗口开、记报错、能用的 localStorage
- `lib/check.js` —— 体检、整页截图、存 PDF
- `lib/browser.js` —— 无头 Chrome / Edge（CDP 管道，闲置自动关）
- `lib/client.js` —— 客户端（`exports.inject` 是客户端**短服务名**）
- `cordis.patch.yml` —— bundle patch

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · 测试：```sh
npm test                                          # 服务端、客户端、模板、体检（有 Chrome / Edge 时用真浏览器）
node e2e/e2e-pages.mjs --dsh 0.2.1-rc.3 [--light] # 临时装一个 DSH 网页版 + 假模型 + 无头 Chrome，整套走一遍
```

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · 已验证：DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.2 / rc.3：临时 DSH 网页版端到端 35 项，深色、浅色各跑一遍（写的时候的卡片、嵌在对话里、高度跟内容、深浅色切换不重载、右侧栏、改出 v2 和翻回 v1、导出 HTML / PNG、全部页面带缩略图、页面里勾的东西重开 DSH 还在、两处同开实时同步、手机宽度、删页面挪进回收站、套模板）。8 个模板各自在真浏览器里点过（勾选、切换、翻卡、答题、图表提示、流程图连线），720 和 390 宽、深浅色都过体检。桌面端用 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 实测：清单、数据看板都自己选对模板、一步到位；不用模板自己写的房贷计算器、个税计算器、旅行 AA 分摊，都用上了同一套设计，深色适配好，体检通过。
@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · 反馈：遇到问题或想要新功能，[提一个 issue](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-pages/issues/new/choose)。报问题时写上 DSH 版本和插件版本，修起来最快。

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Introduction：Let the model in DSH (DeepSeek Harness) turn an answer into a web page: comparisons, checklists, charts, calculators, quizzes... The page is **embedded right under the reply** and works as is. It follows DSH's light/dark theme, and whatever you filled in is still there when you reopen it. Every edit is saved as a new version, and old ones stay one click away. The right sidebar shows the full page, and one click exports PNG / PDF / HTML.

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Introduction：Common page types (reports, comparisons, checklists, dashboards, timelines, flashcards, quizzes, flowcharts) have **ready-made templates**: the model writes only the content, and the plugin handles layout and interaction. It is fast, saves tokens and doesn't break. The model writes a full web page only when no template fits.

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Introduction：> **In one line:** a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin. The model uses `show_page` to turn an answer into a page that shows right in the chat and is interactive. The 8 common templates need content only. Pages follow light/dark, have versions, are checked automatically after saving, and can be exported.
>
> **Use it for:** "Make that into a page", "Build me a mortgage calculator", "Compare these three phones" — whenever a page is clearer than a paragraph of text.
>
> **Install:** on the DSH Plugins page, click Add plugin and enter `@orderg-x/dsh-pages` (an npm package; if npm can't be reached it switches to a mirror in China automatically), then restart DSH.

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Install：**Restart DSH** after installing (the client code is bundled when DSH starts, so the pages won't show up until you restart). The plugin appears as "Pages" on the DSH Plugins page.

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Install：**Updating:** on DSH 0.2.2 or later, open it on the Plugins page and click "Update to …". On older DSH, uninstall it and add it again as above. A new version can be installed about a day after release, because the pnpm that DSH uses skips brand-new versions by default. To get it right away, uninstall it and add the release tarball instead (a tarball install can't use Update later).
@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Install：For development you can link a local directory: enter this repo's absolute path in Add plugin. It installs as `link:`, and code changes also need a restart.

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · What it looks like：1. **While writing:** a skeleton card appears in the tool group: "Writing the page… 12.0 KB written".
2. **When done:** the page is embedded right under the reply, already at the height of its content (measured during the check, so it doesn't jump). If it is too tall it starts collapsed; click "Expand" to see all of it. For long reports the model can choose to show just a thumbnail card.
3. **Right sidebar:** click "Open on the right" to see the full page. At the top you can flip between versions (‹ v2 / 3 ›), export, and refresh. "‹ All pages" lists every page you've made, with thumbnails. The "+" in the right sidebar also has a "My pages" entry.
4. **Edit again:** say "make the title bigger", and the model calls the tool again with the `page_id`, saving v2. In the chat, earlier turns still show v1 and new turns show v2.
5. **My pages:** with many pages you can search by title. To remove one, click "×" then "Delete?", and the whole page moves to the trash (`~/.dsh/dsh-pages/trash/`; move it back into `pages/` to restore it).
6. **On your phone** (with [dsh-mobile](https://github.com/OrderG-X/dsh-mobile)): pages are still embedded in

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Templates：The model passes `template` and `data` (content only), and the plugin lays out the page: colors, light/dark, phone layout, interaction and saving are all built in. This is much faster than having the model write a whole web page from scratch, and it doesn't break. If `data` is wrong, the tool says exactly what is wrong, and the model fixes it.

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Templates：All eight templates share one design: a short blue line and a small category label above the title; big numbers as the stars; a single accent color (DeepSeek blue), with green, red and amber meaning only good, bad and watch out; panels are white with a thin border, and lists are separated by thin lines. Chart colors are picked in an order that stays distinguishable for color-blind users.

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Templates：When a template doesn't fit and the model writes a full HTML page itself (calculators, small games, unusual layouts), the same design is applied on save: headings, body text, tables, buttons and inputs look like this without any styling of their own, and ready-made color variables and classes for headers, panels, big numbers, inputs and switches are available (the tool description lists them for the model). This stylesheet lives in a CSS `@layer`, so the page's own styles always win and nothing gets broken.

| `report` | Reviews, research, summaries | Summary, metric cards, sections (text / list / table / callout), sources |
| `compare` | Choosing a phone or a plan | Switch between cards and table, "Differences only", best value marked automatically (higher or lower is better), recommended item highlighted |

| `flashcards` | Vocabulary, concepts | Click a card to flip it, "Got it" counter, show only the ones you haven't got, shuffle |
| `quiz` | Self-tests, making questions | Click to see right or wrong, with explanation and score, retry |
| `flow` | Approvals, step-by-step procedures | Layers laid out automatically, branches, cross-layer and backward connectors routed around each other |
@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Templates：Text can use `**bold**`, `` `code` ``, and `[links](https://…)`. Button text on the page follows the language of the content (Chinese / English).

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Light and dark：- Cards and the right sidebar use DSH's own design variables, so they follow DSH.
- The page itself switches too, **without reloading** (filled-in forms and dragged sliders stay as they are). When the page is sent out, a small script is added that sets `data-theme="light|dark"`, `data-bs-theme`, `.dark` and `color-scheme` on `<html>`. Your own variables, Tailwind, DaisyUI and Bootstrap all pick it up.
- A `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` written in the page is also changed to follow DSH (if DSH is set to dark and the system is light, the page still goes dark).
- Pages the model writes itself come with the light/dark variables of the design above (`--bg` `--surface` `--fg` `--muted` `--line` `--accent` and so on). Use them and the page switches automatically.

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Automatic check：After saving, the page is opened in an invisible Chrome / Edge on your machine (with the same sandbox as in the chat). It takes a second or two, and the result goes to the model together with the tool result:

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Automatic check：- Script errors, libraries that fail to load from the CDN, requests blocked by the sandbox
- Blank page
- Horizontal overflow at chat width (720px) and phone width (390px), naming the element
- A light background in dark mode
- Embedding it the way the chat does and measuring the embedded height; pages that use 100vh plus margins and keep growing are called out

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Automatic check：For anything blocked by the sandbox, the message says how to fix it (for example "the page can't fetch data over the network, write the data into the page directly"), and the model just follows it.

If there are problems, the model fixes them and calls the tool again; if there are none, no more checking is needed. It also grabs a light and a dark thumbnail for "My pages". If Chrome / Edge isn't installed, the check is skipped.

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Usage：| Parameter | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | Yes | Page title, keep it short |
| `template` | One of the two | Use a template: `report` / `compare` / `checklist` / `dashboard` / `timeline` / `flashcards` / `quiz` / `flow`, together with `data` |
| `data` | With a template | The template's content (JSON). Each template's fields are in the tool description; for examples see `test/fixtures/template-samples.mjs` |
| `html` | One of the two | Without a template: a complete, self-contained HTML page; write styles and scripts in the page, and libraries can be loaded from cdn.jsdelivr.net / cdnjs.cloudflare.com / unpkg.com |
| `page_id` | No | To edit an existing page, pass the `page_id` returned last time; it is saved as a new version |

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Security：- **Pages are locked in a sandbox:** the response header carries `Content-Security-Policy: sandbox allow-scripts …`, so the page runs in an opaque origin and can't reach DSH's APIs or cookies. `connect-src 'none'` means no fetch / XHR / WebSocket. Images, audio and video accept only `data:` / `blob:` (icons can be loaded from the three CDNs), so a page can't build an image URL out of what the user typed and send it out. Scripts and styles can only be loaded from the three CDNs.
- **Pages that navigate away on their own:** during the check this is always blocked and the model is told. In the chat, a page that navigates away is pulled back to the original page. Still, a browser can't stop the navigation before it is sent, so don't type passwords or the like into a page.
- **Login required:** both the page and the APIs have their login checked by DSH's own `connection` service. Older DSH versions without that service accept only local connections and check Host / Sec-Fetch-Site / Origin (against DNS rebinding and cross-site requests).
- **APIs that change things** (export, show in folder, delete page, save page data) accept only JSON sent from the

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Where it's stored：`~/.dsh/dsh-pages/pages/<page_id>/`: `meta.json` (title, versions, check results), `v1.html` (the HTML exactly as the model gave it), `v1.jpg` / `v1-dark.jpg` (thumbnails), `state.json` (the page's own localStorage). Deleted pages are in `~/.dsh/dsh-pages/trash/`. Exported files go to Downloads.

@orderg-x/dsh-pages README · Architecture：- `lib/index.js` — tools, routes, gatekeeping, export
- `lib/design.js` — the shared design (color variables, base look, ready-made classes), used by templates and hand-written pages
- `lib/templates.js` — the 8 templates: content validation, layout, the small in-page interaction scripts
- `lib/store.js` — saving pages, versions and page data, deleting pages (writes to the same page are queued)
- `lib/runtime.js` — the small script injected into pages: light/dark, reporting height, opening external links in a new window, logging errors, a working localStorage
- `lib/check.js` — the check, full-page screenshots, saving PDF
- `lib/browser.js` — headless Chrome / Edge (CDP over a pipe, closed automatically when idle)
- `lib/client.js` — the client (`exports.inject` is the client **short service name**)
- `cordis.patch.yml` — bundle patch
